subject: Request: Extended POC credits and one-off concession for NextWave AI
messages:
From: Ethan Ross <ethan.ross@nextwave.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 10 Aug 2026 11:22:00 -0700
Subject: Urgent: POC overage + ask for extra credits/extension

Hi Kimberly,

Quick one — team ran a heavier eval than expected during the past week and we've significantly exceeded the free PLG allotment for the POC tied to ND-4567. Usage attached (summary + rough cost impact). We love the latency profiles and want to continue but need a little runway.

Would Redwood be open to a one-time increase in POC credits (1M additional token-equivalent) and an extra 60 days on the POC window? This is critical for our internal stakeholders to complete an architecture validation and procurement review.

If there are any commercial prerequisites (e.g., a short-term pilot commitment or SOW amendment), let us know — we can move fast. Procurement is cc'd but I wanted to start here.

Thanks,
Ethan Ross
Head of Platform, NextWave AI
E: ethan.ross@nextwave.ai
A: NextWave AI

Attachments: usage_report_aug01-10.csv
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 10 Aug 2026 15:05:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Urgent: POC overage + ask for extra credits/extension

Hi Ben / Priyom — forwarding Ethan's note from NextWave (attached usage CSV + original SOW). Short summary: unexpectedly high eval usage; prospect asks for 1M token-equivalent credit + 60-day extension to finish infra validation.

Why this matters: NextWave is a high-potential mid-market AI infra buyer (CIO and head of platform engaged). They sign quickly once infra validation completes; highest likelihood of converting to Dedicated in Q4 if we avoid a hard stop now.

Asks:
- Can Deal Desk approve a one-off credit and extension? If yes, what level ($ / tokens) and any commercial conditions we should require?
- If we need exec approval, who should I loop in (CRO, CFO)?

I attached the usage report and the POC SOW for context. I'm recommending we treat this as an escalated trial extension rather than a free-for-all; prefer conditional approval (e.g., extension + credit contingent on a short-term commitment or a technical checkpoint).

--
Kimberly Park
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0122

Attachments: NextWave_POC_SOW.pdf, usage_report_aug01-10.csv
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 10 Aug 2026 19:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Urgent: POC overage + ask for extra credits/extension

Kim / Priyom — looked through the usage CSV and SOW. The spike is front-loaded (model sweeps across long sequences), so it's a legitimate overage rather than abuse. Good signal.

Numbers (quick calc): the POC to date used ~1.25M token-eq more than expected; if we grant a 1M token credit that's roughly in line with their ask but leaves a small potential gap. My risk-aware recommendation: approve 1M token-equivalent credit + 30-day extension as a one-off, conditioned on:

- A short amendment to the SOW capturing the extension and our credit line;
- A technical checkpoint within 30 days confirming infra validation;
- Procurement confirms ability to sign a 6-month evaluation/commitment within 60 days (soft commitment ok).

If Sales wants the full 60-day extension request, we should escalate to Laura for a CRO-level exception (because it's outside standard PLG flex).

I'll draft the amendment language if we get signoff.

Ben
Ben Carter
Deal Desk Manager, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 10 Aug 2026 21:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Urgent: POC overage + ask for extra credits/extension

Thanks Ben — I ran the margin hit scenarios and the economics are reasonable for a one-time concession because the conversion probability is high. Breakdown:
- Proposed concession: 1,000,000 token-equivalent credit (one-off) + 45-day extension
- Estimated near-term ARR upside if converted to Dedicated: ~$180k ARR; payback within first 3 months of dedicated usage.
- Conditions: SOW amendment + procurement acknowledgement + technical checkpoint.

Requesting CRO sign-off (Laura) for the 45-day + credit. If Laura prefers a smaller extension, Ben's 30-day recommendation is acceptable.

Linking HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/ND-4567 — has the current forecast and notes.

Priyom Das
Director, Sales Operations, Redwood Inference
priyom.das@redwood.com
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 12 Aug 2026 08:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Urgent: POC overage + ask for extra credits/extension

Approve.

Decision: One-time 1,000,000 token-equivalent credit + 45-day POC extension. Conditions:
1) Execute a short SOW amendment that records the extension and the credit;
2) NextWave provides a technical checkpoint within the 45 days;
3) If NextWave does not commit to a minimum 6-month Dedicated trial or a documented procurement timeline by the end of the extension, the credit is considered final and non-recoupable (no retro billing).

Ben / Priyom — please prepare the amendment and the credit entry. Kimberly — you have approval to inform NextWave and capture the procurement acknowledgement. Please keep Finance in the loop so they can provision the credit in the billing system.

Laura Bennett
VP Revenue, Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Ethan Ross <ethan.ross@nextwave.ai>
Cc: procurement@nextwave.ai, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 12 Aug 2026 15:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Urgent: POC overage + ask for extra credits/extension

Ethan — good news. Redwood has approved a one-time concession to help NextWave finish the infra validation:

- 1,000,000 token-equivalent credit (one-time)
- 45-day extension to the POC window (starts today)

Conditions we discussed: we will add a short amendment to the SOW to document the extension and the credit. Please provide a preferred contact in procurement who can confirm the procurement timeline (procurement@nextwave.ai is cc'd). We also ask for a technical checkpoint with your team inside the 45 days — a short sync is fine.

Ben / Priyom / Finance — please prepare the SOW amendment and the credit posting; confirm when the credit has been applied and I'll relay that to NextWave.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
